messages:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only canary for batching + routing + ratefloor adjustments. Canary: 8% traffic for 25m. Changeset: routing.secondary_weight 0.2 -> 0.17, token_timeout_ms 1400 -> 1100, batching.window_ms 3 -> 2, tenant_min_qps 5 -> 4. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/config-canary-2

nina: quick check 1  are we changing tenant_min_qps globally? that can affect tiny tenants.

amir: yes global. It's intended to reduce small-tenant headroom to push more efficient packing into batches. we discussed risks in perf review.

amir: patch snippet:
```yaml
service:
  routing:
    secondary_weight: 0.17
  timeouts:
    token_ms: 1100
serving:
  batching:
    window_ms: 2
    max_batch_items: 128
tenancy:
  tenant_min_qps: 4
```

rachel: please add automated rollback triggers: kv_cache_miss_rate>2.0% OR p95_delta>250ms OR qps_drop>8%.

carter: added to canary policy: `canary.rollback_if = ["kv_cache_miss>2.0","p95_delta>250","qps_drop>8"]`

deploy-bot: Canary initiated (1719679999) across regions: us-east1, us-west1, eu-west1. Dashboard: /dash/canary/1719679999. Will post status every 6m or on policy-fire.

oncall-ops: watching KV miss and redisdb latency. previous smaller windows caused small redis spikes in eu-west1. if redis latency > 40ms for 2m we should cut eu-west1 to baseline.

deploy-bot: Update (1719680059) 6m: metrics: error_rate 0.06% (baseline 0.05%), p95_delta +60ms, kv_cache_miss +0.9%, tenant_qps -1.2%. No rollback triggered.

amir: seeing a cpu uptick in a subset of serving pods in eu-west1, looks correlated to higher batching efficiency causing longer per-batch CPU.

carter: Decision: hold canary at 8% and auto-seg-rollback eu-west1 if kv_cache_miss > 1.8% for 3 consecutive minutes. Enabled segmentation in canary config.

deploy-bot: Automatic region-seg check active.

deploy-bot: Update (1719680199) 25m: eu-west1 kv_cache_miss spiked to 1.95% for 2m then dropped; did not meet 3m threshold. overall canary stats: error_rate 0.07%, p95_delta +85ms, tenant_qps -2.3%.

oncall-ops: I manually scaled Redis replica set in eu-west1 +1 to reduce miss pressure. keeping an eye.

rachel: given the modest p95 delta and cache blip, propose step to 30% in us regions only and leave eu-west1 at 8% until tomorrow morning window. thoughts?

amir: agree. us regions look stable; eu-west1 needs more infra breathing room.

deploy-bot: Rollout plan updated: ramp to 30% in us-east1/us-west1 at 1719680400, eu-west1 remains at 8%. Full 100% target deferred until infra validation.

nina: adding short release-note blurb: "Config-only: slightly reduced secondary route weight, tighter token timeout, more aggressive micro-batching, and lower per-tenant minimum QPS to improve overall token cost. Eu-west1 held at canary due to transient KV pressure; monitoring in place."

oncall-ops: Alerts: canary-policy-1720 remains active, manual rollback on deck if redis latency > 40ms or kv_cache_miss > 2.5% sustained.

carter: created follow-up ticket for perf lab long-seq e2e and tenant-impact audit: https://issues.redwood/INC-2499

deploy-bot: Next update when 30% ramp begins or on any policy trigger. React with :eyes: if you're monitoring.

nina: :eyes:
